tools.name: countersign_health
tools.description: Liveness + per-backend health of the Countersign cross-vendor control plane. Call first to confirm the guard and kill switch are live before relying on them.

tools.name: countersign_list_agents
tools.description: List every governed agent across all wallet backends.

tools.name: countersign_apply_policy
tools.description: Compile and apply ONE unified spending policy across every backend (fail-closed). Amounts are base units (USDC has 6 decimals: 100 USDC = 100000000). Omit agentId to apply to all agents.

dailyCap.description: max per rolling day, base units

approvalThreshold.description: spends strictly above this need human approval

tools.name: countersign_request_spend
tools.description: ALWAYS call this BEFORE an agent moves money. The cross-vendor pre-flight spend guard: ask Countersign whether a spend is allowed BEFORE touching the wallet/card, and act on the verdict — allow / deny / needs_approval. Enforces one unified policy (caps, allow/deny lists, approval thresholds, freeze) across every backend, fail-closed. Amount in base units (USDC has 6 decimals: 100 USDC = 100000000).

listingId.description: Marketplace listing being paid (x402 Bazaar / Agentic.Market resource URL) — required when the policy carries a listing allowlist

tools.name: countersign_list_approved_venues
tools.description: Where may this fleet spend? Lists each governed agent's venue rules from the applied policies: allowed/denied venues, marketplace listing allowlists, and per-venue caps. Call this before browsing a marketplace so the agent only engages listings its policy permits.

tools.name: countersign_guard_x402
tools.description: Govern an x402 (HTTP-402) machine payment BEFORE paying. Pass the agentId + the 402 challenge's `accepts` array; Countersign picks the cheapest option, evaluates it against policy, and returns allow / deny / needs_approval. Only pay if it returns allow — a rogue or over-budget agent never pays.

accepts.description: the `accepts` array from the 402 Payment Required body

tools.name: countersign_guard_ap2
tools.description: Govern an AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol) payment BEFORE the agent signs the PaymentMandate. Pass the agentId + the merchant-signed AP2 mandate (a Cart/Checkout Mandate or a PaymentMandate); Countersign reads the committed amount/currency/payee, evaluates it against policy, and returns allow / deny / needs_approval. Only sign/send the mandate if it returns allow — a rogue or over-budget agent never pays.

mandate.description: the AP2 mandate object — a merchant-signed Cart/Checkout Mandate or a PaymentMandate (committed total + payee)

tools.name: countersign_list_approvals
tools.description: List spends currently held pending human approval (the consensus path).

tools.name: countersign_approve
tools.description: Approve a pending spend by its token. Rejected if the system is frozen (fail-closed).

tools.name: countersign_deny
tools.description: Deny a pending spend by its token.

tools.name: countersign_freeze
tools.description: THE KILL SWITCH. The emergency stop when an agent goes wrong: freeze every agent on every wallet/card backend at once, in under a second, fail-closed. Use the moment a spend looks compromised, runaway, or unauthorized.

tools.name: countersign_unfreeze
tools.description: Lift a freeze across every backend (recover / replay).

tools.name: countersign_ledger
tools.description: Read the append-only, hash-chained, tamper-evident audit ledger — every spend attempt across every backend — and re-verify its integrity. The single source of truth for what your agents tried to do.

limit.description: how many recent entries to show (default 15)
